definitions.gloss: stain removal; the act of removing stains
definitions.explanation: The process of removing stains from clothing, fabric, or other surfaces.
A product or tool designed for removing stains, such as a cleaning solution or stain-removing pen.

notes:
Combines シミ (stain, spot) and ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ (removal, from ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧). A practical household term used in daily life, laundry, and cleaning contexts. シミ is often written in katakana in this compound, though ⟦{染|し}み→染み：05426_shimi⟧ is also seen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- シミ{取|と}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to remove stains
- シミ{取|と}り⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧: stain removal agent
- シミ{取|と}り⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧: stain remover pen
- シミ{取|と}り⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧: stain remover spray
- シミ{取|と}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to send out for stain removal (dry cleaning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{漂白|ひょうはく}→漂白：16995_hyouhaku⟧: bleaching — a more aggressive method of removing discoloration
- {汚|よご}れ{落|お}とし: dirt/grime removal — broader term for cleaning off various types of soiling
- ⟦クリーニング→クリーニング：19551_kuriiningu⟧: dry cleaning — professional garment cleaning service
